name: campfire
description: A tall campfire pane in a deep forest under the stars: flames lick and sparks crackle up, flowers ring the clearing, forested ridges rise behind, and now and then a fox trots by or an owl perches and swivels its head. While Claude works the fire roars up; when it is done it dies back down.
